d: Bihar ke mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke drim projekt 'kushal yuva karyakram' par gahraya sankat ab prashasnik bavandar ka rup le chuka hai. pichhle 8 mahinon se rajy ke 1,731 kevaeepi sentar band hone aur 2 lakh se jyada namankit chhatron ki kanpyutar va kaushal shiksha thap hone ke virodh men aandolankari sanchalkon ne aar-par ki jang ka ailan kar diya hai.
